Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Pet posture selection new screen in adoption: Add a new posture selection screen in adoption allowing users to select how their pet rests on the desktop screen. (why: Adoption has a 72.4% conversion rate and support received complaints about custom pets looking wrong; selecting posture beforehand sets accurate visual expectations.)
1: [finish, new_flow] Desktop pet wake up celebration flow: Introduce a mascot celebration stage flow on the home intro screen when desktop setup completes. (why: The finish step sees a 64.8% completion rate with a long median duration (395s); an engaging wake-up moment improves onboarding completion sentiment.)
2: [choose_path, new_screen] Path choice preview gallery new screen: Insert a preview screen right before choose path showing a carousel of sample pets created via each path. (why: The choose_path step has a long mean duration of 514s; previewing outcomes visually helps users decide faster.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop render stage progress indicator: Display a explicit render progress bar component with status updates during the rendering wait screen. (why: Home wait step has a mean duration of 2336s and median 201s; explicit rendering stage feedback reduces perceived wait time and drop-offs.)
4: [finish, copy] Desktop pet visibility guidance body copy update: Update the home intro text to explain how to summon, control, or hide the desktop pet via the system tray. (why: Support mail received 3 confusion emails regarding controls and 3 bug reports about pets missing on desktop after onboarding.)
5: [adoption, layout] Adoption certificate compact preview layout: Switch the adoption certificate screen to a compact layout. (why: Adoption funnel drops to 72.4% with mean 1017s duration; a compact layout streamlines completion.)
6: [sign_in, hint] Account switch pet recovery reminder hint: Add a hint box on the sign in screen reminding returning users to sign in with their original account method. (why: 8 support emails reported lost pets due to logging into a different account during reinstall or sign-in.)
